Test one hypothesis with several matched-pair statistics

Source: R/rosenbaum-pairs.R
riposte_pairs_test.Rd

Convenience wrapper: builds the score columns with riposte_pairs_scores() and calls riposte_pairs_bound().

Usage

riposte_pairs_test(
  y,
  statistics = c("u878", "u867"),
  gamma = 1,
  alternative = c("greater", "less"),
  dose = NULL,
  algorithm = NULL
)

Arguments

y

matched-pair differences (treated minus control).

statistics

character vector from "wilcoxon", "brown", "noether", "u858", "u888", "u878", "u868", "u867" (U-statistics with m = 8). Default: the two U-statistics u878 and u867 highlighted in Rosenbaum (2012).

gamma

sensitivity parameter.

alternative

"greater" or "less".

dose

optional nonnegative weights (e.g. doses) multiplying every score.

algorithm

passed to riposte_pairs_bound().

Value

a riposte_pairs_bound() list.
